court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sarita W/O Gorakh Pawar And Another vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vinod Ganesh Pawar, Ragini w/o Ganesh Pawar, Sarita W/O Gorakh Pawar, Hema W/o Manish @ Manashshe Reed, Manish @ Manashshe Mozes Reed
parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Maharashtra, Mrs. Disha w/o Vinod Pawar

facts_of_case: Petitioners are husband and mother-in-law seeking relief. Respondents are the state and informant.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can amicably settle matrimonial disputes and withdraw criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The parties have arrived at an amicable settlement of the matrimonial dispute. Petitioner no.1 husband and respondent no.2 have filed a petition under section 13 (1) (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act for divorce by mutual consent before the learned Civil Judge S.D. Shrirampur.

legal_principles.principle: Consent of the parties is necessary to quash criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The respondent no.2 has filed her personal affidavit before this Court affirming the aforesaid facts and records her consent for quashing of the criminal proceeding arising out of crime no.267 of 2022.

outcome.final_order: The final court order is not mentioned in this excerpt.
